offering_description.value: Distributes propane, heating oil and other fuels to households, businesses, farms and public facilities through local service centers and delivery fleets. It also markets natural gas and electricity in deregulated markets, produces renewable natural gas, and installs and services fuel systems and heating and cooling equipment.

primary_products.value: Propane, including renewable propane; heating oil and other refined fuels; natural gas, including renewable natural gas; electricity; heating and cooling equipment

primary_services.value: Propane tank leasing and installation; heating and cooling equipment installation, maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households using propane or heating oil, or buying natural gas or electricity; B2B: Commercial and industrial facilities, farms, fleet operators and wholesale energy buyers; B2G: Government facilities and public school districts

end_markets.value: Residential energy; commercial and institutional facilities; agriculture; industrial operations; transportation fleets

revenue_model.value: product sales: Fuel and electricity sold by volume or consumption, plus equipment sales; service fees: Equipment installation, maintenance and repair; rental or leasing: Propane tanks placed at customer sites
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Sources and delivers bulk fuels to households, businesses, farms and public facilities; retailer: Buys natural gas and electricity for resale to households and businesses in deregulated markets; service provider: Installs and maintains fuel systems and heating and cooling equipment for homes and businesses; asset operator: Operates fuel storage and delivery fleets and processes organic waste into gas for energy buyers
value_chain_position.category: distributor; retailer; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: US national: Customers across the Northeast, South, Midwest and West

specialization.value: related lines: Propane, refined fuels, natural gas and electricity marketing, renewable gas production, and equipment services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Residential and commercial sales teams arrange fuel delivery and equipment service; own locations: Local customer service centers dispatch company delivery trucks and technicians; online: Customer portal accepts fuel orders from existing accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Federal hazardous-material transport rules, state and local fuel storage and fire codes, and state energy supplier licensing

notes: The current footprint of the renewable natural gas operations is uncertain.
